topic: Conduits types, and insulation of wires in aircraft.
syllabus_extract: Conduits types, and insulation of wires in aircraft.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of wiring routing standards and insulation types; Instructor supervision on safety protocols.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of aircraft wiring degradation?
List the common types of conduits used in aircraft wiring.
Why is proper insulation critical for aircraft electrical systems?

development.content:
Types of Aircraft Conduits
Rigid vs Flexible Conduit Applications
Conduit Installation Standards
Conduit Sizing and Routing
Conduit Termination Methods

Wire Insulation Materials
Insulation Degradation Mechanisms
Environmental Factors Affecting Insulation
Insulation Repair Techniques
Selection of Insulation Types

Integrated Conduit and Insulation Systems
Maintenance Inspection Procedures
Preventive Measures for Degradation
Documentation and Reporting
Safety Considerations in Wiring

summary_questions: Explain how environmental factors contribute to wiring degradation.
Differentiate between rigid and flexible conduit applications in aircraft.
Describe the steps involved in inspecting conduit and insulation integrity.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the differences between conduit types and their specific applications in aircraft wiring, referencing the next lesson plan on practical repair techniques.

pft_rows.syllabus: Practical on aircraft wiring routing and repair like crimping, insulating using heat sleeve, Solder sleeve etc.
